name: The Pinkman Files
source:
The story revolves around Pinkman, a young man that's just moved to Uruguay in search of a more relaxed life. However... shortly upon getting accustomed to the residents of this small town, it seems something much greater is being hidden from you.

Who really is telling the truth?

Well, that doesn't matter! You'll surely always be humoured all throughout!

Maybe even giggle a bit...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3854540/The_Pinkman_Files/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕刚刚搬到乌拉圭、希望过上悠闲慢生活的青年平克曼展开。然而……就在你刚刚熟悉这座小镇的居民们没多久，背后似乎正隐藏着某个大得多的惊人秘密。

究竟谁说的才是实话？

好啦，那都无所谓！反正你这一路上肯定会被逗得乐不可支！

说不定还会忍不住咯咯笑出声来呢……

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3854540/The_Pinkman_Files/]Steam[/url]]
